About Meridian

Intelligence is the
original capital.

Meridian is a global intelligence and private capital firm that deploys capital across AI, financial technology, and high-growth emerging markets. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in New York with offices in London and Singapore, the firm manages $4.2B in assets under management on behalf of sovereign wealth funds, institutional investors, and family offices.

Our thesis is simple: sustainable alpha lives at the intersection of proprietary intelligence and decisive capital deployment. We identify structural shifts before they become consensus, then commit capital with conviction — and operate with the urgency the moment demands.

Meridian operates as an integrated intelligence-and-capital platform, not a traditional fund. Our 40-person research division continuously maps global macroeconomic shifts, geopolitical dynamics, and technology adoption curves. This intelligence feeds directly into every investment decision we make.

Since inception, the firm has completed 73 investments across 18 countries, achieving a portfolio-weighted IRR of 28.4%. We have returned $1.9B to our LPs through 19 full or partial exits. Our people are our most valuable asset — a team of former Goldman Sachs executives, McKinsey partners, Rhodes Scholars, and operational leaders who've built category-defining businesses.

Our Approach
01

Intelligence-First

Our proprietary platform synthesizes 200+ real-time data signals across macro, geopolitical, and technology domains. Every investment thesis is intelligence-led, not opportunity-chased.

02

Global Conviction

We operate across 18 active markets with on-the-ground presence in New York, London, and Singapore. Our edge lies in understanding what moves capital across borders before others see it.

03

Operational Partnership

Capital is table stakes. We deploy operational expertise, strategic networks, and institutional infrastructure alongside every dollar we invest — transforming portfolio companies into market leaders.
